definitions.explanation: Literary works from earlier eras regarded as having lasting value, especially the classical literature of Japan such as Heian-period works. May also refer to the classics of any country.

{源氏物語|げんじものがたり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古典文学|こてんぶんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表作|だいひょうさく}→代表作：09952_daihyousaku⟧だ。
examples.english: The Tale of Genji is a representative work of Japanese classical literature.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧ (classic, classical work) + ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ (literature).
